issues.finding: The frozen clause says that not B is true exactly when B is true, omitting the required negation of B's satisfaction condition.
issues.proposed_resolution: State that not B is true at w exactly when B is not true at w.

issues.finding: The frozen clause makes B implies C true when B or C is true; the antecedent must instead be false or the consequent true.
issues.proposed_resolution: State that B implies C is true at w exactly when B is not true at w or C is true at w.

issues.finding: Both clauses print the malformed TeX expression \mSat/{M}{!B}[w] instead of the established satisfaction macro \mSat{M}{!B}[w].
issues.proposed_resolution: Use the established \mSat{M}{!B}[w] notation in both translated clauses.
